description: An MCP server for counting the number of R's in Strawberry and more.

readme.content: # Strawbery-MCP An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides a tool to count the correct number of R's in "strawberry". ## Features - Case-insensitive character counting - Supports Unicode characters, including CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) - Returns count and 1-indexed positions of matches - JSON response format ## Tool: strawberry-count ### Parameters - `input` (string, required): The string to search in - `character` (string, required): The single character to count (must be exactly one Unicode rune) ```json { "character": "r", "input": "strawberry" } ``` ### Response JSON object with: - `count` (int): Number of occurrences - `positions` (array of int): 1-indexed positions where the character appears ```json { "count": 3, "positions": [ 3, 8, 9 ] } ``` ### Examples - Input: `{"input": "strawberry", "character": "r"}` → `{"count": 3, "positions": [3,6,8]}` - Input: `{"input": "你好", "character": "你"}` → `{"count": 1, "positions": [1]}` ## Running the Server This server uses SSE for MCP communication. ### Local ```bash go run main.go ``` ### Container ```bash docker build -t strawbery-mcp . && docker run -p 3001:3001 strawbery-mcp ``` ### Add To OpenCode Add to the `$.mcp` block of your `opencode.jsonc` ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "mcp": { "strawbery": { "type": "remote", "url": "http://localhost:3001/sse", "enabled": true } } } ```
